headlines.text: It was 2025 when Konosuke Takeshita vs. Jon Moxley met in a Continental Classic League Match, in the show-closing main event slot on Collision, rated 8.59 ? a stone-cold classic. In a match focused entirely on Moxley's knee, Takeshita used dragon screws and the steel steps before a Blue Thunder Bomb through the commentary table and a second Raging Fire driver sealed his Continental Classic win, handing Moxley his second loss of the tournament.

Turning the clock back to 2023: the AEW TNT Title was up for grabs as Christian Cage vs. Adam Copeland went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.91. For Adam Copeland, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. It was the 80th time the AEW TNT Title had been on the line, a real piece of championship history. Nick Wayne's mother blindsided Copeland with the TNT Title belt, letting Christian steal the win with the Killswitch in the first-ever singles meeting between the former tag partners in 13 years.
Back on this day in 2024, Ricochet vs. Komander met in a Continental Classic League Match, serving as the night's main event on Rampage, rated 7.58 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle.

secondaries.text: Rewind to 2023, when Swerve Strickland vs. Mark Briscoe met in a Continental Classic League Match on Dynamite, rated 8.01 ? one of the better matches of the year.
Back on this day in 2025, Mascara Dorada vs. Claudio Castagnoli met in a Continental Classic League Match on Collision, rated 7.44 ? a match that delivered.
Rewind to 2025, when Ricochet vs. Ace Austin put the AEW National Title on the line, appearing on Collision, rated 6.58.
